Several open spellbooks float in the air, their pages turning by themselves, glowing runes lifting off the parchment and drifting away.
A great brass orrery turns slowly in the center of the room, its planets and moons casting moving shadows across the walls.
Shelves of potion bottles glow in a dozen colors, casting shifting jewel-toned light across the cluttered wooden shelves.
A crystal ball rests on a carved obsidian stand, its interior churning with slow silver mist and half-glimpsed images.
A summoning circle chalked on the stone floor glows faintly blue, its geometric lines precise and slightly warm to the touch.
A floating quill dips itself into an inkwell and writes steadily across a long scroll, filling line after line without pause.
A caged tiny elemental paces its brass enclosure, flickering between flame and smoke, leaving scorch marks on the cage floor.
A telescope mounted on a brass swivel points through an open aperture in the ceiling, tracking slowly across the night sky.
Star-charts cover every inch of one wall, pinned edge to edge, with small glowing dots marking positions updated by invisible hands.
Runes drift slowly through the air like lazy sparks, cycling through a dozen languages before dissolving against the cold stone walls.
A bubbling alchemical apparatus of glass tubes and copper coils fills one corner, dripping a luminous green liquid into a flask.
A glowing orb of swirling golden light hovers near the ceiling, pulsing gently as though breathing, illuminating the room with warmth.
Jars of glowing specimens line a high shelf, each containing something preserved in bright fluid that shifts color in the dark.
A large hourglass filled with silver sand runs continuously, yet the sand never seems to diminish or accumulate on either side.
A skull on the desk occasionally mutters to itself, its jaw clicking softly as it recites forgotten incantations under its breath.
A mirror on the wall reflects the room with a slight delay, showing the space as it appeared several moments before.
Bundles of dried herbs and strange roots hang from the rafters, releasing a faint aromatic smoke that never quite fully dissipates.
A stack of ancient tomes reshuffles itself periodically, sliding books in and out of order as though searching for a particular page.
A small clockwork dragon perches on a bookshelf, its jeweled eyes following movement in the room with a soft mechanical whirring.
A bowl of still black water sits on a stone plinth, its surface occasionally rippling outward from the center without any cause.
Long chains of glowing sigils hang suspended between the rafters like garlands, rotating slowly and humming at a frequency felt in the chest.
A worn armchair floats a foot off the floor before the fireplace, rocking gently as though some invisible figure sits reading there.
An astrolabe the size of a cartwheel spins slowly on a wall mount, its brass rings clicking into new alignments every few minutes.
A narrow cabinet stands open, its interior far too deep for its outer dimensions, filled with scrolls receding into impossible darkness within.
Candles throughout the room burn in colors no natural flame produces, casting violet, deep green, and cold white light across the stones.
